candidates.statement: Checkout p95 latency is 437ms while all other gateway routes are ~4.75ms; traces show the order path dominated by payment authorization (~23ms) and postgres save_order (~15ms) spans, indicating downstream latency on the order/payment/postgres chain.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show sub-30ms spans; the 437ms p95 is not clearly reproduced in sampled traces, so the dominant slow segment is not fully localized.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout p95 (437ms) far exceeds other routes (~4.75ms) with all 200s and no 502s, so this is latency not errors. Traces show the checkout fan-out through order, inventory, payment and postgres. Downstream latency is the best bounded candidate; logs were excluded and no deployment or memory-retention facts are present.
